verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְשָׁלֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־ אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יְהוֹאָחָ֨ז בֶּן־ יֵה֤וּא עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שְׁבַ֥ע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·šā·lōš šā·nāh lə·yō·w·’āš ben- ’ă·ḥaz·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz ben- yê·hū ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn šə·ḇa‘ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh
verses.literal: In the twenty-third . . . year . . . of the reign of Joash son of Ahaziah over Judah Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel and he reigned in Samaria seventeen . . . years
verses.literalPt: NO ano vinte e três de Joás, filho de Acazias, rei de Judá, começou a reinar Jeoacaz, filho de Jeú, sobre Israel, em Samaria, e reinou dezessete anos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ֠יֵּלֶךְ אַחַ֨ר חַטֹּ֜את יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא־ סָ֥ר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·yê·leḵ ’a·ḥar ḥaṭ·ṭōṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lō- sār mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and followed . . . the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit he did not turn away from them
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR; porque seguiu os pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, que fez pecar a Israel; não se apartou deles.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֞ם בְּיַ֣ד׀ חֲזָאֵ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֗ם וּבְיַ֛ד בֶּן־ הֲדַ֥ד בֶּן־ חֲזָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yit·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ ḥă·zā·’êl me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ū·ḇə·yaḏ ben- hă·ḏaḏ ben- ḥă·zā·’êl kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He delivered them continually . . . into the hands of Hazael king of Aram . . . and his son Ben-hadad
verses.literalPt: Por isso a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Israel; e entregou-os na mão de Hazael, rei da Síria, e na mão de Ben-Hadade, filho de Hazael, todos aqueles dias.

verses.original: וַיְחַ֥ל יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֤י רָאָה֙ אֶת־ לַ֣חַץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ לָחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥal yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- pə·nê Yah·weh way·yiš·ma‘ ’ê·lāw Yah·weh kî rā·’āh ’eṯ- la·ḥaṣ yiś·rā·’êl kî- lā·ḥaṣ ’ō·ṯām me·leḵ ’ă·rām
verses.literal: Then Jehoahaz sought the favor of the LORD and the LORD listened to him because He saw the oppression that the king of Aram had inflicted on Israel . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém Jeoacaz suplicou diante da face do SENHOR; e o SENHOR ouviu; porque viu a opressão de Israel, pois o rei da Síria os oprimia.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וַיֵּ֣צְא֔וּ מִתַּ֖חַת יַד־ אֲרָ֑ם וַיֵּשְׁב֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶ֖ם כִּתְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên Yah·weh lə·yiś·rā·’êl mō·wō·šî·a‘ way·yê·ṣə·’ū mit·ta·ḥaṯ yaḏ- ’ă·rām way·yê·šə·ḇū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·’ā·ho·lê·hem kiṯ·mō·wl šil·šō·wm
verses.literal: So the LORD gave Israel a deliverer and they escaped . . . the power of the Arameans Then the people of Israel lived in their own homes as they had before . . .
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR deu um salvador a Israel, e saíram de sob as mãos dos sírios; e os filhos de Israel habitaram nas suas tendas, como no passado

verses.original: אַ֠ךְ לֹֽא־ סָ֜רוּ מֵחַטֹּ֧אות בֵּית־ יָרָבְעָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִי אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣הּ הָלָ֑ךְ וְגַם֙ הָאֲשֵׁרָ֔ה עָמְדָ֖ה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lō- sā·rū mê·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ bêṯ- yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ’ă·šer- hɛ·ḥɛ̆·ṭī ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bāh hā·lāḵ wə·ḡam hā·’ă·šê·rāh ‘ā·mə·ḏāh bə·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: Nevertheless they did not turn away from the sins that the house of Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit but they continued to walk in them The Asherah pole even remained standing in Samaria
verses.literalPt: (Contudo não se apartaram dos pecados da casa de Jeroboão, com que fez Israel pecar; porém ele andou neles e também o bosque ficou em pé em Samaria).

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹא֩ הִשְׁאִ֨יר לִיהוֹאָחָ֜ז עָ֗ם כִּ֣י אִם־ חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים פָּֽרָשִׁים֙ וַעֲשָׂ֣רָה רֶ֔כֶב וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רַגְלִ֑י כִּ֤י אִבְּדָם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַיְשִׂמֵ֥ם כֶּֽעָפָ֖ר לָדֻֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō hiš·’îr lî·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz ‘ām kî ’im- ḥă·miš·šîm pā·rā·šîm wa·‘ă·śā·rāh re·ḵeḇ wa·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm raḡ·lî kî ’ib·bə·ḏām me·leḵ ’ă·rām way·śi·mêm ke·‘ā·p̄ār lā·ḏuš
verses.literal: Jehoahaz had no army left except . . . fifty horsemen ten chariots and ten thousand foot soldiers because the king of Aram had destroyed them and made them like the dust at threshing
verses.literalPt: Porque não deixou a Jeoacaz, do povo, senão só cinqüenta cavaleiros, dez carros e dez mil homens de pé, porquanto o rei da Síria os tinha destruído e os tinha feito como o pó, trilhando-os.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוֹאָחָ֛ז וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וּגְבוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz along with all his accomplishments . . . and his might . . . . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o mais dos atos de Jeoacaz, e tudo quanto fez, e o seu poder, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהֽוֹאָחָז֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·ru·hū bə·šō·mə·rō·wn way·yim·lōḵ yō·w·’āš bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Jehoahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria And his son Jehoash reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E Jeoacaz dormiu com seus pais, e o sepultaram em Samaria; e Jeoás, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יְהוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֤ז עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: biš·naṯ šə·lō·šîm wā·še·ḇa‘ šā·nāh lə·yō·w·’āš me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh mā·laḵ yə·hō·w·’āš ben- yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·šō·mə·rō·wn šêš ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh
verses.literal: In the thirty-seventh . . . year of the reign of Joash over Judah Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria and he reigned sixteen . . . years
verses.literalPt: No ano trinta e sete de Joás, rei de Judá, começou a reinar Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, sobre Israel, em Samaria, e reinou dezesseis anos.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִכָּל־ חַטֹּ֞אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־ הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֥הּ הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śeh hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lō sār mik·kāl ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer- he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bāh hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and did not turn away from all the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had caused Israel to commit but he walked in them
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR; não se apartou de nenhum dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com que fez Israel pecar, porém andou neles.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י יוֹאָשׁ֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וּגְב֣וּרָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחַ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲמַצְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yō·w·’āš wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rā·ṯōw ’ă·šer nil·ḥam ‘im ’ă·maṣ·yāh me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh hă·lō·w- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Jehoash along with all his accomplishments . . . and his might including his war against Amaziah king of Judah are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: Ora, o mais dos atos de Jeoás, e tudo quanto fez, e o seu poder, com que pelejou contra Amazias, rei de Judá, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹאָשׁ֙ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וְיָרָבְעָ֖ם יָשַׁ֣ב עַל־ כִּסְא֑וֹ וַיִּקָּבֵ֤ר יוֹאָשׁ֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ yō·w·’āš ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw wə·yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām yā·šaḇ ‘al- kis·’ōw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr yō·w·’āš bə·šō·mə·rō·wn ‘im mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And Jehoash rested with his fathers and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel
verses.literalPt: E Jeoás dormiu com seus pais, e Jeroboão se assentou no seu trono; e Jeoás foi sepultado em Samaria, junto aos reis de Israel.

verses.original: וֶֽאֱלִישָׁע֙ חָלָ֣ה אֶת־ חָלְי֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָמ֖וּת בּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨רֶד אֵלָ֜יו יוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיֵּ֤בְךְּ עַל־ פָּנָיו֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר אָבִ֣י׀ אָבִ֔י רֶ֥כֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ḥā·lāh ’eṯ- ḥā·lə·yōw ’ă·šer yā·mūṯ bōw way·yê·reḏ ’ê·lāw yō·w·’āš me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·ḇək ‘al- pā·nāw way·yō·mar ’ā·ḇî ’ā·ḇî re·ḵeḇ yiś·rā·’êl ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw
verses.literal: When Elisha had fallen sick with the illness from which he would die Jehoash king of Israel came down to him and wept over him saying My father my father the chariots and horsemen of Israel
verses.literalPt: E Eliseu estava doente da enfermidade de que morreu, e Jeoás, rei de Israel, desceu a ele, e chorou sobre o seu rosto, e disse: Meu pai, meu pai, o carro de Israel, e seus cavaleiros!

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע קַ֖ח קֶ֣שֶׁת וְחִצִּ֑ים וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֵלָ֖יו קֶ֥שֶׁת וְחִצִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ qaḥ qe·šeṯ wə·ḥiṣ·ṣîm way·yiq·qaḥ ’ê·lāw qe·šeṯ wə·ḥiṣ·ṣîm
verses.literal: Elisha told him Take a bow and some arrows So Jehoash took . . . a bow and some arrows
verses.literalPt: E Eliseu lhe disse: Toma um arco e flechas. E tomou um arco e flechas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַרְכֵּ֤ב יָֽדְךָ֙ עַל־ הַקֶּ֔שֶׁת וַיַּרְכֵּ֖ב יָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֧שֶׂם אֱלִישָׁ֛ע יָדָ֖יו עַל־ יְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl har·kêḇ yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘al- haq·qe·šeṯ way·yar·kêḇ yā·ḏōw way·yā·śem ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ yā·ḏāw ‘al- yə·ḏê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then Elisha said to the king of Israel Put your hand on the bow So the king put his hand on the bow and Elisha put his hands on the king’s hands
verses.literalPt: Então disse ao rei de Israel: Põe a tua mão sobre o arco. E pôs sobre ele a sua mão; e Eliseu pôs as suas mãos sobre as do rei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּתַ֧ח הַחַלּ֛וֹן קֵ֖דְמָה וַיִּפְתָּ֑ח וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֤ע יְרֵה֙ וַיּ֔וֹר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חֵץ־ תְּשׁוּעָ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ וְחֵ֣ץ תְּשׁוּעָ֣ה בַֽאֲרָ֔ם וְהִכִּיתָ֧ אֶת־ אֲרָ֛ם בַּאֲפֵ֖ק עַד־ כַּלֵּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer pə·ṯaḥ ha·ḥal·lō·wn qê·ḏə·māh way·yip̄·tāḥ way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ yə·rêh way·yō·wr way·yō·mer ḥêṣ- tə·šū·‘āh Yah·weh wə·ḥêṣ tə·šū·‘āh ḇa·’ă·rām wə·hik·kî·ṯā ’eṯ- ’ă·rām ba·’ă·p̄êq ‘aḏ- kal·lêh
verses.literal: Open the east window said Elisha So he opened it and Elisha said Shoot So he shot And Elisha declared This is the LORD’s arrow of victory the arrow of victory over Aram for you shall strike the Arameans in Aphek until you have put an end to them
verses.literalPt: E disse: Abre a janela para o oriente. E abriu-a. Então disse Eliseu: Atira. E atirou; e disse: A flecha do livramento do SENHOR é a flecha do livramento contra os sírios; porque ferirás os sírios; em Afeque, até os consumir.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר קַ֥ח הַחִצִּ֖ים וַיִּקָּ֑ח וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לְמֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַךְ־ אַ֔רְצָה וַיַּ֥ךְ שָֽׁלֹשׁ־ פְּעָמִ֖ים וַֽיַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qaḥ ha·ḥiṣ·ṣîm way·yiq·qāḥ way·yō·mer lə·me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl haḵ- ’ar·ṣāh way·yaḵ šā·lōš- pə·‘ā·mîm way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: Then Elisha said Take the arrows So he took them and Elisha said to the king of Israel Strike the ground So he struck the ground three times and stopped
verses.literalPt: Disse mais: Toma as flechas. E tomou-as. Então disse ao rei de Israel: Fere a terra. E feriu-a três vezes, e cessou.

verses.original: וַיִּקְצֹ֨ף עָלָ֜יו אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְהַכּ֨וֹת חָמֵ֤שׁ אוֹ־ שֵׁשׁ֙ פְּעָמִ֔ים אָ֛ז הִכִּ֥יתָ אֶת־ אֲרָ֖ם עַד־ כַּלֵּ֑ה וְעַתָּ֕ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים תַּכֶּ֥ה אֶת־ אֲרָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ṣōp̄ ‘ā·lāw ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer lə·hak·kō·wṯ ḥā·mêš ’ōw- šêš pə·‘ā·mîm ’āz hik·kî·ṯā ’eṯ- ’ă·rām ‘aḏ- kal·lêh wə·‘at·tāh šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm tak·keh ’eṯ- ’ă·rām
verses.literal: But the man of God was angry with him and said You should have struck the ground five or six times Then you would have struck down Aram until you had put an end to it But now you will strike down Aram only three times
verses.literalPt: Então o homem de Deus se indignou muito contra ele, e disse: Cinco ou seis vezes a deverias ter ferido; então feririas os sírios até os consumir; porém agora só três vezes ferirás os sírios.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥מָת אֱלִישָׁ֖ע וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֑הוּ וּגְדוּדֵ֥י מוֹאָ֛ב יָבֹ֥אוּ בָאָ֖רֶץ בָּ֥א שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yiq·bə·ru·hū ū·ḡə·ḏū·ḏê mō·w·’āḇ yā·ḇō·’ū ḇā·’ā·reṣ bā šā·nāh
verses.literal: And Elisha died and was buried Now the Moabite raiders used to come into the land every spring . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois morreu Eliseu, e o sepultaram. Ora, as tropas dos moabitas invadiram a terra à entrada do ano.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י הֵ֣ם׀ קֹבְרִ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ וְהִנֵּה֙ רָא֣וּ אֶֽת־ הַגְּד֔וּד וַיַּשְׁלִ֥יכוּ אֶת־ הָאִ֖ישׁ בְּקֶ֣בֶר אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַיֵּ֜לֶךְ וַיִּגַּ֤ע הָאִישׁ֙ בְּעַצְמ֣וֹת אֱלִישָׁ֔ע וַיְחִ֖י וַיָּ֥קָם עַל־ רַגְלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî hêm qō·ḇə·rîm ’îš wə·hin·nêh rā·’ū ’eṯ- hag·gə·ḏūḏ way·yaš·lî·ḵū ’eṯ- hā·’îš bə·qe·ḇer ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yê·leḵ way·yig·ga‘ hā·’îš bə·‘aṣ·mō·wṯ ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·ḥî way·yā·qām ‘al- raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: Once as the Israelites were burying a man suddenly they saw a band of raiders so they threw the man’s body into Elisha’s . . . tomb And as soon as his body touched the bones of Elisha the man was revived and stood up on his feet
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, enterrando eles um homem, eis que viram uma tropa, e lançaram o homem na sepultura de Eliseu; e, caindo nela o homem, e tocando os ossos de Eliseu, reviveu, e se levantou sobre os seus pés.

verses.original: וַֽחֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם לָחַ֖ץ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י יְהוֹאָחָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·zā·’êl me·leḵ ’ă·rām lā·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl kōl yə·mê yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz
verses.literal: And Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz
verses.literalPt: E Hazael, rei da Síria, oprimiu a Israel todos os dias de Jeoacaz.

verses.original: וַיָּחָן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֹתָ֤ם וַֽיְרַחֲמֵם֙ וַיִּ֣פֶן אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם לְמַ֣עַן בְּרִית֔וֹ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם יִצְחָ֣ק וְיַֽעֲקֹ֑ב וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ הַשְׁחִיתָ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ הִשְׁלִיכָ֥ם מֵֽעַל־ פָּנָ֖יו עַד־ עָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥān Yah·weh ’ō·ṯām way·ra·ḥă·mêm way·yi·p̄en ’ă·lê·hem lə·ma·‘an bə·rî·ṯōw ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām yiṣ·ḥāq wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh haš·ḥî·ṯām wə·lō- hiš·lî·ḵām mê·‘al- pā·nāw ‘aḏ- ‘āt·tāh
verses.literal: But the LORD was gracious to Israel and had compassion on them and He turned toward them because of His covenant with Abraham Isaac and Jacob And to this day the LORD has been unwilling to destroy them or cast them from His presence
verses.literalPt: Porém o SENHOR teve misericórdia deles, e se compadeceu deles, e tornou-se para eles por amor da sua aliança com Abraão, Isaque e Jacó, e não os quis destruir, e não os lançou ainda da sua presença.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת חֲזָאֵ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ בֶּן־ הֲדַ֥ד בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ḥă·zā·’êl me·leḵ- ’ă·rām way·yim·lōḵ ben- hă·ḏaḏ bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: When Hazael king of Aram died his son Ben-hadad reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E morreu Hazael, rei da Síria e Ben-Hadade, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֜שָׁב יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֗ז וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הֶֽעָרִים֙ מִיַּד֙ בֶּן־ הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־ חֲזָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֗ח מִיַּ֛ד יְהוֹאָחָ֥ז אָבִ֖יו בַּמִּלְחָמָ֑ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ פְּעָמִים֙ הִכָּ֣הוּ יוֹאָ֔שׁ וַיָּ֖שֶׁב אֶת־ עָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ yə·hō·w·’āš ben- yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm mî·yaḏ ben- hă·ḏaḏ ben- ḥă·zā·’êl ’ă·šer lā·qaḥ mî·yaḏ yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz ’ā·ḇîw bam·mil·ḥā·māh šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm hik·kā·hū yō·w·’āš way·yā·šeḇ ’eṯ- ‘ā·rê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz took back from Ben-hadad son of Hazael the cities that Hazael had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz Jehoash defeated Ben-hadad three times and so recovered the cities of Israel
verses.literalPt: E Jeoás, filho de Jeoacaz, tornou a tomar as cidades das mãos de Ben-Hadade, que ele tinha tomado das mãos de Jeoacaz, seu pai, na guerra; três vezes Jeoás o feriu, e recuperou as cidades de Israel.
